name: Voxel Texture Atlas UV Mapping
definition: A technique to map voxel face types and directions to a 2D texture atlas using calculated UV coordinates, with safety margins to prevent texture bleeding.
summary: Voxel Texture Atlas UV Mapping maps voxel faces to a 2D texture atlas with calculated UVs and safety margins, differing from standard methods by explicitly handling discrete voxel faces and applying per-voxel shading logic.
